warnings.detail: Increased reporting rate of rhabdomyolysis with Baycol relative to other statins, especially when gemfibrozil is co-prescribed

Severe muscle damage. Combination of cerivastatin and another cholesterol lowering drug, gemfibrozil, has caused severe damage to muscle in some patients. The damage can be in the form of rhabdomyolysis where there is breakdown of muscle cells and release of myoglobin which in turn can lead to kidney damage
